finding: A LinkedIn carousel must deliver a useful standalone argument and a coherent next action. For the shopping-agent edition, the final card introduces thinking effort and says Link in the post text; the caption contains that next-read link. The original shopping article belongs in a separately labelled background comment. Do not place a long raw URL on the card, depend on clickable image/PDF links, or promise the first comment will be visible. No engagement benefit for comment links has been established. Preserve personal voice and require human publication.

evidence.result: Krish rejected the robotic/raw-URL final card, required a seamless continuation, accepted preparation of v3, and explicitly chose manual Buffer publication. No live outcome inferred.

revisit_when: A new edition changes the promised destination, or a native post reveals a broken continuation; validate the full reader journey rather than mechanically copying the CTA.
